title: 第6章 被亡灵天灾——伊莱克斯看上了
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“亡灵？！”

千仞雪眼神危险地一眯，随后手中的天使圣剑瞬间转向，转而朝着朝她飞来的灰色光团狠狠挥去。

天使圣剑裹挟着极其强悍的神圣气息目标直指伊莱克斯，其中的力量明明是朝着伊莱克斯去的，却也让天梦冰蚕一动也不敢动。

生怕眼前的女子将伊莱克斯砍了的同时，瞬间带它一个，那它不是刚逃出来就寄了？

可它根本不知道伊莱克斯这四个字的含金量，不光它不知，千仞雪同样不知道。于是——

又是一声熟悉的声音响起，千仞雪挥出去的剑又一次被轻松挡住，定睛去看，让千仞雪眼神一凛。

她的剑居然连这个诡异灰团的边都碰不到？

那这个灰团的实力要有多可怕？

“果然，老夫没感觉错，很浓郁的光明与火的气息，身上甚至还有神的气息。你是这个位面的光明之子？”

“什么光明之子？亡灵就当诛！”

说完这话，千仞雪真正认真了起来。

全身魂力涌动，六翼天使武魂现！

且一经释放便放出净化邪祟的光芒，若是之前在斩杀邪魂师时，千仞雪召唤武魂，都不用动手，30级以下的魂师能瞬间被净化，这便是完成过天使神前七考的底气。

可对伊莱克斯没用，不过千仞雪也没指望这个。

与此同时，她脚下飞快浮现自身魂环。

黑，黑，黑，黑，黑，黑，红，红！

这令人咋舌的配置一出，足以让天梦冰蚕在内心惊呼“乖乖”，更加不敢动了。

可伊莱克斯却趣味更深了。

原本稍稍停住的动作恢复，再次朝着千仞雪飞去。

“哼！天使领域，开！”

然而根本没用！

这下子千仞雪震惊得双眸张大，但她并没有放弃。

“有意思！太有意思了！本座还是第一次见到如此属性和性格都合我胃口的人，我越来越想知道你身上到底发生了什么，不光有神的气息，还有斗罗位面的......呵呵~”

这笑声在千仞雪听来极为刺耳，也有一种自己的秘密被人知道想要灭口的滔天杀意，所以，她下一招直接用了全力。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Undead?!"

Qian Renxue's eyes narrowed dangerously, and then the angel holy sword in her hand instantly turned and swung hard at the gray light ball flying towards her.

The Angel Holy Sword was wrapped with an extremely powerful sacred aura and aimed directly at Electrolux. The power in it was obviously heading towards Electrolux, but it also made Tianmeng Iceworm dare not move.

He was afraid that the woman in front of him would chop Electrolux and take it with him in an instant. Didn't he send it just after escaping?

But it doesn't know the value of the four words "Electrolux" at all. Not only does it not know, Qian Renxue also doesn't know.So——

Another familiar voice sounded, and Qian Renxue's sword was easily blocked again. Qian Renxue looked at it intently, making Qian Renxue's eyes shudder.

Her sword couldn't even touch the edge of this weird gray ball?

So how terrifying is the strength of this gray ball?

"Sure enough, I felt it right. There is a very strong aura of light and fire, and there is even the aura of God on your body. Are you the son of light in this plane?"

"What son of light? The dead shall be punished!"

After saying this, Qian Renxue became really serious.

Soul power surges throughout the body, and the seraphic spirit appears!

And once released, it emits a light that purifies evil spirits. If Qian Renxue had summoned the martial spirit when killing the evil soul master before, she would not have to do anything. Soul masters below level 30 could be purified instantly. This is the confidence to complete the first seven tests of the Angel God.

It was of no use to Electrolux, but Qian Renxue didn't expect this.

At the same time, her own soul ring quickly appeared under her feet.

Black, black, black, black, black, black, red, red!

The appearance of this astonishing configuration was enough to make Tianmeng Iceworm exclaim "Good boy" in her heart, and she didn't dare to move even more.

But Electrolux was even more interesting.

The movement that had stopped for a moment resumed and flew towards Qian Renxue again.

"Hmph! Angel Realm, open!"

But it’s no use at all!

Qian Renxue's eyes widened in shock, but she did not give up.

"Interesting! So interesting! This is the first time I have seen someone with such attributes and personality that suits my taste. I want to know more and more what happened to you. Not only do you have the aura of God, but also the Douluo plane... Haha~"

This laughter sounded extremely harsh to Qian Renxue, and she also had a murderous intention to silence her if her secret was known, so she used all her strength in her next move.
